biography:
Anything you build on a large scale or with intense passion invites chaos.” – Francis Ford Coppola As a third-generation construction professional, I’ve inherited more than a trade, I’ve inherited a mindset. One shaped by decades of hands-on problem-solving, resilience, and a deep respect for the complexity of building things that last. That foundation has guided my journey from the jobsite to the global stage, where I now lead teams scaling technology infrastructure at Microsoft. I’ve learned that chaos is inevitable when you're building at scale. But it’s also where the most meaningful innovation happens. My role is to harness that chaos, aligning strategy, people, and systems to deliver infrastructure that supports the exponential growth of Microsoft’s cloud. From my roots as a union electrician to my current leadership role, every step has been driven by a commitment to continuous learning and operational excellence. I’ve led through ambiguity, scaled operations across the Americas, and built high-performing teams that thrive under pressure. Optimism has been my compass. When the challenges seem insurmountable, it’s belief, in the mission, the team, and the process, that drives progress. Building what others deem impossible requires more than technical skill, it demands vision, resilience, and the ability to inspire. As our team continues to grow, I’m always looking to connect with those who share a passion for solving complex problems and building what matters. If you're curious about how your unique skills can contribute to Microsoft’s mission of empowering every person and organization on the planet to achieve more, let’s talk.
"Anything you build on a large scale or intense passion invites chaos" - Francis Ford Coppola

Steering teams through the labyrinth of scaling complexities, I've learned that no amount of preparation can fully shield us from the unforeseen. My mission has been to harness this chaos, optimizing the delivery of technology infrastructure with an unwavering sense of responsibility.

Every role I've held has been a steppingstone in my journey of growth and development. This mindset of continuous learning has propelled me from my roots as a union electrician to my current role in a team that's scaling technology infrastructure on a global scale. This trajectory is a testament to my relentless pursuit of knowledge and the resilience that has enabled me to tackle increasingly formidable challenges.

As the magnitude of these challenges has amplified over the course of my career, I've realized the irreplaceable value of unwavering optimism in surmounting the seemingly insurmountable. To build anything of significance, one must embody optimism, for by its very nature, such an endeavor is often deemed impossible by many.

As we strive to keep pace with the exponential growth of Microsoft's cloud, our team is constantly expanding. If you're curious about how your unique skills can contribute to Microsoft's mission of empowering every individual and organization on the planet to achieve more, I encourage you to reach out. Let's explore the possibilities together!
